Aqui está um **relatório detalhado** sobre os **Chefes/Lembranças (Remembrances)** do DLC *Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree*, considerando apenas o DLC, e as **recompensas que podem ser trocadas** por cada uma.

---

## 📋 Visão Geral

- **O que são Remembrances?**  
  São itens/special Tools obtidos ao derrotar certos chefes no DLC *Shadow of the Erdtree*. Cada Remembrance pode ser:
    - **Consumido** para gerar muitas runas.
    - **Trocado com Finger Reader Enia** no *Roundtable Hold* por **uma das duas opções** (Reward #1 ou Reward #2).
    - **Duplicado** em *Stone Coffins* (3 locais) para ter ambas as opções.

- **Como trocar:**  
  Ir ao *Roundtable Hold*, dialogar com Enia e escolher o item desejado entre os dois.  
  Alternativamente, usar as *Stone Coffins* nos três locais encontrados (Cathedral de Manus Metyr, Finger Ruins de Rhia, Finger Ruins de Dheo) para duplicar o Remembrance e obter ambos os itens.

---

## 🗒️ Lista de Remembrances (principalmente os mais conhecidos)

Abaixo estão os Remembrances mais destacados do DLC, com o nome do boss, a recompensa principal (Reward #1) e outra opção (Reward #2). Para a lista completa de todos os 15+ Remembrances, consulte o artigo da [Eurogamer](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-remembrance-bosses-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) ou o wiki Fandom.

### 1. **Remembrance of the Dancing Lion** (Divine Beast Dancing Lion)
- **Boss:** Divine Beast Dancing Lion (Belurat, Tower Settlement)
- **Reward #1:** Enraged Divine Beast (charm que aumenta potência das tempestades)
- **Reward #2:** Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp (armamento com frio)

### 2. **Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight** (Rellana, Twin Moon Knight)
- **Boss:** Rellana, Twin Moon Knight (Castle Ensis)
- **Reward #1:** Rellana's Twinblade (Light Greatsword dupla-faca)
- **Reward #2:** Rellana's Twin Moons (sorcery conjura luas encarnadas)

### 3. **Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider** (Commander Gaius)
- **Boss:** Commander Gaius (Shadow Keep, Back Gate)
- **Reward #1:** Sword Lance (Heavy Thrusting Sword combinado greadaxe + lança)
- **Reward #2:** Blades of Stone (sorcery que puxa pedaços de rocha)

### 4. **Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower** (Scadutree Avatar)

- **Reward #2:** Bloodboon (incantação que cria chamas)

Perfeito! Encontrei informações relevantes. Vamos analisar o que foi encontrado:

- **Remembrances** (ou "Lembranças") são itens/special Tools obtidos ao derrotar certos chefes no DLC *Elden Ring* (Shadow of the Erdtree, etc.).
- Eles podem ser usados para obter uma grande quantidade de runas ou serem trocados por recompensas.

Vou acessar o wiki oficial do Elden Ring para detalhes específicos sobre cada Remembrance e as recompensas disponíveis para trocar.

# Remembrances | Elden Ring Wiki

[![ER Main Menu Icon Power of Rememberance](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/eldenring/images/3/38/ER_Main_Menu_Icon_Power_of_Rememberance.png/revision/latest?cb=20230503091942)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/eldenring/images/3/38/ER_Main_Menu_Icon_Power_of_Rememberance.png/revision/latest?cb=20230503091942)

| --- | --- |

**Remembrances** are special [Tools](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Tools "Tools") that are obtained upon defeating certain bosses in *[Elden Ring](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring_(game) "Elden Ring (game)")*. They can either be used to obtain a large amount of [runes](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Runes "Runes") or traded with [Finger Reader Enia](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Finger_Reader_Enia "Finger Reader Enia") for exclusive items.

## Remembrance Duplication[]

[Wandering Mausoleums](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Wandering_Mausoleum "Wandering Mausoleum") and [Remembrance Coffins](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Remembrance_Coffin "Remembrance Coffin") can be used once each to duplicate a Remembrance, even if the Remembrance has already been used. Mausoleums with bells can duplicate any remembrance, but the two mausoleums without bells at the [![Sites of Grace](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/ER_Map_Icon_Site_of_Grace.png)](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Sites_of_Grace "Sites of Grace") Mausoleum Compound site of grace can only duplicate a Legend remembrance. Coffins found in the [Shadow of the Erdtree expansion](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring:_Shadow_of_the_Erdtree "Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree") can duplicate any remembrance.

tool_trace.content:
O texto do wiki é muito longo e contém informações sobre Remembrances, mas não lista explicitamente todas as recompensas que podem ser trocadas por cada uma. Preciso encontrar detalhes específicos sobre **como trocar** um Remembrance por recompensas (não apenas runas). Vou buscar mais detalhes sobre a troca de Remembrance com Enia no Roundtable Hold ou outras opções.

Vamos acessar o artigo sobre "Every Elden Ring Remembrance and how to use them" do Polygon ou o link da wiki para recompensas de troca.

# How to use every Remembrance in Elden Ring

There are 15 Remembrances in Elden Ring that are dropped by bosses. They can be consumed to obtain a lot of runes, or exchanged for nifty rewards. It’s even possible to duplicate them to get more out of them.

Our Elden Ring Remembrances guide will help you with everything you need to know about these boss items and their rewards.

---

## **How to exchange and duplicate Remembrances in Elden Ring**

Every Remembrance in Elden Ring can be consumed and converted into runes. However, since there are plenty of rune farming methods out there, doing this isn’t always necessary.

Instead, you’re better off [visiting Roundtable Hold](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough/23054151/roundtable-hold-npcs-encounters) to talk to Finger Reader Enia. Defeating some bosses adds thematic items — like armor pieces — to Enia’s shop. More importantly, the Remembrances themselves can be exchanged by selecting the “Obtain power from Remembrance” dialogue option. Each Remembrance in Elden Ring can be exchanged for two different rewards.

![Every Elden Ring Remembrance and how to use them](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23438222/Elden_Ring_Remembrances_boss_items_rewards_guide___1a.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5)

It’s also possible to duplicate them by entering Walking Mausoleums. These enormous ambulatory chapels require you to clear the gray skull-growths in order to gain access. You’ll then be able to interact with a coffin that duplicates a Remembrance, including those that have already been used. You can only duplicate one Remembrance per Mausoleum.

![Every Elden Ring Remembrance and how to use them](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23438231/Elden_Ring_Remembrances_boss_items_rewards_guide___1b.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5)

Duplicating Remembrances means you can grab both rewards from a specific Remembrance in a single run if you want. But remember that there are more Remembrances than Walking Mausoleums, so you should choose your rewards wisely.

All Remembrances you have will carry over to a subsequent New Game+ run, but they can’t be duplicated until you defeat that particular boss.

---

## **Remembrance of the Grafted**

![Elden Ring screenshot of Godrick the Grafted](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23438237/Elden_Ring_Remembrances_boss_items_rewards_guide___2.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

Boss: [Godrick the Grafted](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough/22960296/godrick-the-grafted-weakness-location-boss-fight-stormveil-castle-strategy-rune)  
Location: [Stormveil Castle](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough/22957293/stormveil-castle-map-tips-tricks-hidden-path-strategy-knight-map)

Reward #1: **Axe of Godrick**

- Type: Greataxe
- Stat requirement: Str 34 and Dex 22
- Stat scaling: Str D and Dex D
- Special skill or effect: I Command Thee, Kneel!

Reward #2: **Grafted Dragon**

- Type: Fist
- Stat requirement: Str 20, Dex 14, and Fai 16
- Stat scaling: Str D, Dex D, and Fai D
- Special skill or effect: Bear Witness!

---

## **Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen**

![Elden Ring’s Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23438251/Elden_Ring_Remembrances_boss_items_rewards_guide___3.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5)Rennala, Queen of the Full MoonImage: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

Boss: [Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough/22969148/rennala-tips-tricks-strategy-raya-lucaria-academy-boss-weapons-armor-talisman)  
Location: [Academy of Raya Lucaria](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough/22971221/academy-of-raya-lucaria-map-tips-tricks-hidden-path-illusory-wall-strategy-red-wolf-radagon-rennala)

Reward #1: **Carian Regal Scepter**

- Type: Staff
- Stat requirement: Str 8, Dex 10, and Int 60
- Stat scaling: Str E, Dex E, and Int B
- Special skill or effect: Spinning Weapon; boosts Full Moon sorcery.

Reward #2: **Rennala’s Full Moon**

- Type: Incantation
- Stat requirement: Int 70
- Stat scaling: N/A
- Special skill or effect: Incarnate a Full Moon and launch it at enemies.

---

## **Remembrance of the Blasphemous**

tool_trace.content: Vamos acessar o artigo da Eurogamer "All Remembrance bosses in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree" para obter a lista completa dos 15 Remembrances e suas recompensas.

# All Remembrance bosses in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree

Here's every Remembrance boss in Shadow of the Erdtree, and their legendary reward items.

![Messmer the Impaler holds a ball of flame aloft while clutching his spear in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-messmer-the-impaler.jpg?width=690&quality=85&format=jpg&dpr=3&auto=webp) Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

There are plenty of bosses to fight in [Elden Ring](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-walkthrough-8042)'s [Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-tips-and-tricks) DLC, but the toughest are definitely its **Remembrance bosses**. These enemies are categorised by the **Remembrances** they drop on defeat, allowing you to trade them in for powerful weapons, spells and items back at the Roundtable Hold.

Some of the Remembrance bosses in Elden Ring's DLC also double up as some of the [main bosses for Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-main-boss-order) that you'll need to beat as part of the story, but there are plenty more that are completely optional. To help you find and defeat them all, we've listed **all Remembrance bosses in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree** below, along with details on **what reward items you can get** by giving their Remembrances to Finger Reader Enia.

**WARNING: This page contains spoilers for Shadow of the Erdtree's bosses, including the final boss of the game. Advance at your own risk!**

On this page:

- [All Remembrance Bosses in Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-remembrance-bosses-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree#section-1)
- [All Remembrance Boss rewards in Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-remembrance-bosses-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree#section-2)

[![Cover image for YouTube video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/JblbR93fNDk/hqdefault.jpg)7 Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree Beginners Tips - A REFRESHER COURSE FOR FORGETFUL TARNISHED[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/JblbR93fNDk?autoplay=1](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/JblbR93fNDk?autoplay=1)](https://www.youtube.com/embed/JblbR93fNDk?autoplay=1 "Click to play video from YouTube")

[Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JblbR93fNDk)

---

## All Remembrance Bosses in Shadow of the Erdtree

Shadow of the Erdtree has **10 Remembrance bosses** to beat in the DLC, and these are:

- Divine Beast Dancing Lion
- Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
- Commander Gaius
- Scadutree Avatar
- Messmer, The Impaler
- Romina, Saint of the Bud
- Putrescent Knight
- Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
- Metyr, Mother of Fingers
- Radahn, Consort of Miquella

---

## All Remembrance Boss rewards in Shadow of the Erdtree

When you beat a Remembrance boss, you'll gain their Remembrance. While these items can be consumed to earn more runes, they can also be exchanged for powerful items that belonged to or represented the boss you defeated. You can exchange Remembrances for these items with **Finger Reader Enia** at the [Roundtable Hold](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-get-roundtable-hold-elden-ring-8042), which you can fast travel back to at any point during Shadow of the Erdtree.

Each Remembrance gives you a choice of items to pick from, but you can only use it to get one of them, so you'll need to think carefully about which reward you want to claim. That said, it’s also possible to use Stone Coffins in the Shadow Realm to [duplicate Remembrances](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-all-remembrance-duplication-locations) so that you can redeem both items. However, like the Walking Mausoleums in Elden Ring's base game, these still have limited uses. We've only found three Stone Coffins in the Shadow Realm so far, and each one only lets you duplicate a Remembrance once, so to get every Remembrance item will require multiple playthroughs.

To help you make your decision, we've got a full list of all possible Remembrance rewards from Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree’s major bosses below:

---

### Remembrance of the Dancing Lion

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Divine Beast Dancing Lion in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-dancing-lion.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Divine Beast Dancing Lion](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-divine-beast-dancing-lion-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Belurat, Tower Settlement)

**Rewards:**

- **Enraged Divine Beast:** A charm that raises the potency of storms.
- **Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp:** Grants an armament the Cold affinity and the 'Divine Beast Frost Stomp' skill, which imitates the wrath of the divine beast's dance. Lift a leg up high and stamp it down with great force. Sends a powerful wave of frost straight out along the ground, and can be charged to increase power and range. Usable on all melee armaments.

---

### Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Rellana Twin Moon Knight in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-rellana.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Rellana, Twin Moon Knight](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-rellana-twin-moon-knight-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Castle Ensis)

**Rewards:**

- **Rellana's Twinblade:** A Light Greatsword that lets you wield two swords as a single armament.

This sword requires 13 Strength, 16 Dexterity, 16 Intelligence and 16 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (D), Intelligence (D) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +103, Magic +66, Fire +66 and Critical +100, and it weighs 8.0.

Its special skill is '**Moon-and-Fire Stance**', which lets you assume a ready stance, and imbue your swords with magic. Follow up with normal attacks to cast glintstone light waves, or a strong attack to perform a spinning attack that bathes the area with flame. Light waves can have up to two follow-up casts with additional inputs.

- **Rellana's Twin Moons:** A Sorcery spell that conjures incarnate twin moons that repeatedly strike the ground.

It requires 72 Intelligence to use, has an FP Cost of 47, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Commander Gaius in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-gaius.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Commander Gaius (Shadow Keep, Back Gate)

**Rewards:**

- **Sword Lance:** A Heavy Thrusting Sword that combines a greatsword and a lance.

This weapoon requires 21 Strength and 11 Dexterity to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (C) and Dexterity (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +132 and Critical +100, and it weighs 9.0,

Its special skill is '**Spinning Gravity Thrust**', which is a gravity skill honed by the disciples of an Alabaster Lord. It uses gravitational power to hang in the air before rotating the body and charging forward. An additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

- **Blades of Stone:** A Sorcery spell that pulls blade-like clumps of rock from the earth. Charging increases potency.

It requires 48 Intelligence to use, has an FP Cost of 18, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Scadutree Avatar in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-scadutree-avatar.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Scadutree Avatar (Shadow Keep, Scadutree Base)

**Rewards:**

- **Shadow Sunflower Blossom:** A Colossal Weapon that takes the form of the head of a monstrous shadow sunflower.

This weapon requires 24 Strength, 8 Dexterity and 25 Faith to wield effectively, and sacles with Strength (D), Dexterity (E) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +114, Holy +114 and Critical +100, and it weighs 16.0.

Its special skill is '**Shadow Sunflower Headbutt**', which slams down the blossom of a large shadow sunflower, sending out a shockwave that flattens foes. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

- **Land of Shadow:** An Incantation spell that creates a hail of golden projectiles which are fired toward foes after a brief delay.

It requires 58 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 40, and requires 1 Memory Slot.

---

### Remembrance of the Impaler

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Messmer the Impaler in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-messmer.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Messmer the Impaler](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-beat-messmer-the-impaler-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Shadow Keep)

**Rewards:**

- **Spear of the Impaler:** A Greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. It can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.

This weapon requires 14 Strength, 35 Dexterity and 18 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (E), Dexterity (C) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +85, Fire +102 and Critical +100, and it weighs 9.5.

Its special skill is '**Messmer's Assault**', which is a fierce succession of attacks using a flame-coasted spear tip. Repeated inputs allow up to two follow-up attacks. The final move thrusts the spear into the ground, causing countless spears to form in the surrounding area.

- **Messmer's Orb:** An Incantation spell that summons Messmer's flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay. Charging enhances potency.

It requires 60 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 48, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Romina Saint of the Bud in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-romina.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Romina, Saint of the Bud](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-romina-saint-of-the-bud-strategy-elden-ring-shadow-erdtree) (Ancient Ruins of Rauh)

**Rewards:**

- **Poleblade of the Bud:** A Halberd whose attacks cause a passive build-up of scarlet rot (55).

This weapon requires 14 Strength, 22 Dexterity and 20 Arcance to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (E), Dexterity (D) and Arcane (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +131 and Critical +100, and it weighs 10.0.

Its special skill is '**Romina's Purification**', which imbues the bud-blade with scarlet rot butterflies before unleashing two large sweeping slashes.

- **Rotten Butterflies:** An Incantation spell that summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle twirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction.

It requires 33 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 48, and requires 1 Memory Slot.

---

### Remembrance of the Putrescence

![An icon of the boss remembrance for the Putrescent Knight in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-putrescent-knight.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Putrescent Knight](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-putrescent-knight-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Stone Coffin Fissure)

**Rewards:**

- **Putrescence Cleaver:** A Greataxe that gains power from the wielder's arcane attribute. It also has a passive effect that causes frost build-up (55).

This weapon requires 28 Strength, 10 Dexterity and 15 Arcane to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (E) and Arcane (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +141, Magic +42 and Critical +100, and it weighs 13.5.

Its special skill is '**Spinning Guillotine**', which lets you hold the putrid blade at both ends and arch your body backwards to deliver a powerful overhead chop. Repeated inputs deliver follow-up attacks for as long as stamina allows. Strong attacks perform a leap followed by a spinning attack.

- **Vortex of Putrescence:** A Sorcery spell that launches a whirl of putrescent jets that explode shortly after impact and bathe the area in ghostflame.

It requires 32 Intelligence and 26 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 29, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Midra Lord of Frenzied Flame in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-midra.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame (Abyssal Woods)

**Rewards:**

- **Greatsword of Damnation :** A Greatsword whose barbs pierce its victims from within.

This weapon requires 20 Strength, 15 Dexterity and 20 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (E) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +123, Holy +79 and Critical +100, and it weighs 8.0

Its special skill is '**Golden Crux**', which lets you leap up and skewer foes from overhead. If successful, the weapon's barbs unfold to excruciate from within. Additional inputs release barbs in the area.

- **Midra's Flame of Frenzy:** An Incantation spell that summons an apparition of the Lord's head to spew frenzied flame. This incantation can be used while in motion, and the apparition will remain for as long as the input is held.

It requires 41 Intelligence to use, has an FP cost of 22, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Metyr Mother of Fingers in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-metyr.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Metyr, Mother of Fingers (Cathedral of Manus Metyr)

**Rewards:**

- **Staff of the Great Beyond:** A Glintstone Staff that can be used as a catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations.

This weapon requires 7 Strength, 25 Intelligence and 25 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (E), Intelligence (D) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +27, Critical +100 and Sorcery Scaling +60, and it weighs 2.5.

It has no special skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.

- **Gazing Finger:** A Colossal Weapon that uses the head of Metyr without modification.

This weapon requires 20 Strength, 8 Dexterity, 20 Intelligence and 14 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (C), Intelligence (D) and Faith (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +133, Magic +86 and Critical +100, and it weighs 15.0.

Its special skill is '**Kowtower's Resentment**', which performs a violent bow using a finger's foremost protrusion. Resentment builds as it is forced to bow, making it explode with anger. Hold the button down to further increase resentment.

---

### Remembrance of a God and a Lord

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Radahn Consort of Miquella in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-radahn.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Radahn, Consort of Miquella](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-promised-consort-radahn-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Enir-Ilim)

**Rewards:**

- **Greatsword of Radahn (Lord):** A Colossal Sword that's one of a pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

This weapon requires 32 Strength, 24 Dexterity and 15 Intelligence to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (D) and Intelligence (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +127, Magic +82 and Critical +100, and it weighs 19.0.

Its special skill is '**Promised Consort**', which imbues the two greatswords with the light of Miquella, then delivers a slashing attack accompanied by columns of light. Additional input allows for up to two follow-up attacks.

- **Greatsword of Radahn (Light):** A Colossal Sword that's one of a pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

This weapon requires 32 Strength, 24 Dexterity and 15 Intelligence to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (D) and Intelligence (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +127, Magic +82 and Critical +100, and it weighs 19.0.

Its special skill is '**Lightspeed Slash**', which assumes a luminous form and leaps forward to deliver a downward slash at the speed of light. This attack will be followed up by an additional light attack. Charge to increase power of the skill and number of follow-up attacks.

- **Light of Miquella:** An Incantation spell that annihilates foes with a pillar of light.

It requires 72 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 48, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

Need more help? Improve your stats by finding all of Shadow of the Erdtree's [Scadutree Fragment locations](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-scadutree-fragment-locations-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) and [Revered Spirit Ash locations](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-revered-spirit-ash-locations-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree). Alternatively, see which [Erdtree bosses](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-main-boss-order) you've still got left to beat, and track down some great [new early weapons](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-early-weapon-locations) to help you on your adventure.

# Remembrance Bosses | Elden Ring Wiki

**Remembrance Bosses** are a type of [boss](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Bosses "Bosses") in *[Elden Ring](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring_(game) "Elden Ring (game)")* and *[Shadow of the Erdtree](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring:_Shadow_of_the_Erdtree "Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree")*.

## Overview[]

Defeating a [Remembrance Boss](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Remembrance_Boss "Remembrance Boss") grants their corresponding [Remembrance](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Remembrance "Remembrance"), which can be traded to [Finger Reader Enia](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Finger_Reader_Enia "Finger Reader Enia") for one of two unique [items](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Items "Items"). Additionally, the Remembrance becomes available for duplication at any [Wandering Mausoleum](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Wandering_Mausoleum "Wandering Mausoleum") or [Remembrance Duplication Coffin](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Remembrance_Duplication_Coffin "Remembrance Duplication Coffin").

# All Remembrance bosses in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree

Here's every Remembrance boss in Shadow of the Erdtree, and their legendary reward items.

![Messmer the Impaler holds a ball of flame aloft while clutching his spear in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-messmer-the-impaler.jpg?width=690&quality=85&format=jpg&dpr=3&auto=webp) Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

There are plenty of bosses to fight in [Elden Ring](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-walkthrough-8042)'s [Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-tips-and-tricks) DLC, but the toughest are definitely its **Remembrance bosses**. These enemies are categorised by the **Remembrances** they drop on defeat, allowing you to trade them in for powerful weapons, spells and items back at the Roundtable Hold.

Some of the Remembrance bosses in Elden Ring's DLC also double up as some of the [main bosses for Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-main-boss-order) that you'll need to beat as part of the story, but there are plenty more that are completely optional. To help you find and defeat them all, we've listed **all Remembrance bosses in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree** below, along with details on **what reward items you can get** by giving their Remembrances to Finger Reader Enia.

**WARNING: This page contains spoilers for Shadow of the Erdtree's bosses, including the final boss of the game. Advance at your own risk!**

On this page:

- [All Remembrance Bosses in Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-remembrance-bosses-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree#section-1)
- [All Remembrance Boss rewards in Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-remembrance-bosses-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree#section-2)

[![Cover image for YouTube video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/JblbR93fNDk/hqdefault.jpg)7 Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree Beginners Tips - A REFRESHER COURSE FOR FORGETFUL TARNISHED[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/JblbR93fNDk?autoplay=1](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/JblbR93fNDk?autoplay=1)](https://www.youtube.com/embed/JblbR93fNDk?autoplay=1 "Click to play video from YouTube")

[Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JblbR93fNDk)

---

## All Remembrance Bosses in Shadow of the Erdtree

Shadow of the Erdtree has **10 Remembrance bosses** to beat in the DLC, and these are:

- Divine Beast Dancing Lion
- Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
- Commander Gaius
- Scadutree Avatar
- Messmer, The Impaler
- Romina, Saint of the Bud
- Putrescent Knight
- Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
- Metyr, Mother of Fingers
- Radahn, Consort of Miquella

---

## All Remembrance Boss rewards in Shadow of the Erdtree

When you beat a Remembrance boss, you'll gain their Remembrance. While these items can be consumed to earn more runes, they can also be exchanged for powerful items that belonged to or represented the boss you defeated. You can exchange Remembrances for these items with **Finger Reader Enia** at the [Roundtable Hold](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-get-roundtable-hold-elden-ring-8042), which you can fast travel back to at any point during Shadow of the Erdtree.

Each Remembrance gives you a choice of items to pick from, but you can only use it to get one of them, so you'll need to think carefully about which reward you want to claim. That said, it’s also possible to use Stone Coffins in the Shadow Realm to [duplicate Remembrances](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-all-remembrance-duplication-locations) so that you can redeem both items. However, like the Walking Mausoleums in Elden Ring's base game, these still have limited uses. We've only found three Stone Coffins in the Shadow Realm so far, and each one only lets you duplicate a Remembrance once, so to get every Remembrance item will require multiple playthroughs.

To help you make your decision, we've got a full list of all possible Remembrance rewards from Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree’s major bosses below:

---

### Remembrance of the Dancing Lion

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Divine Beast Dancing Lion in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-dancing-lion.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Divine Beast Dancing Lion](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-divine-beast-dancing-lion-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Belurat, Tower Settlement)

**Rewards:**

- **Enraged Divine Beast:** A charm that raises the potency of storms.
- **Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp:** Grants an armament the Cold affinity and the 'Divine Beast Frost Stomp' skill, which imitates the wrath of the divine beast's dance. Lift a leg up high and stamp it down with great force. Sends a powerful wave of frost straight out along the ground, and can be charged to increase power and range. Usable on all melee armaments.

---

### Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Rellana Twin Moon Knight in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-rellana.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Rellana, Twin Moon Knight](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-rellana-twin-moon-knight-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Castle Ensis)

**Rewards:**

- **Rellana's Twinblade:** A Light Greatsword that lets you wield two swords as a single armament.

This sword requires 13 Strength, 16 Dexterity, 16 Intelligence and 16 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (D), Intelligence (D) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +103, Magic +66, Fire +66 and Critical +100, and it weighs 8.0.

Its special skill is '**Moon-and-Fire Stance**', which lets you assume a ready stance, and imbue your swords with magic. Follow up with normal attacks to cast glintstone light waves, or a strong attack to perform a spinning attack that bathes the area with flame. Light waves can have up to two follow-up casts with additional inputs.

- **Rellana's Twin Moons:** A Sorcery spell that conjures incarnate twin moons that repeatedly strike the ground.

It requires 72 Intelligence to use, has an FP Cost of 47, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Commander Gaius in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-gaius.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Commander Gaius (Shadow Keep, Back Gate)

**Rewards:**

- **Sword Lance:** A Heavy Thrusting Sword that combines a greatsword and a lance.

This weapoon requires 21 Strength and 11 Dexterity to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (C) and Dexterity (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +132 and Critical +100, and it weighs 9.0,

Its special skill is '**Spinning Gravity Thrust**', which is a gravity skill honed by the disciples of an Alabaster Lord. It uses gravitational power to hang in the air before rotating the body and charging forward. An additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

- **Blades of Stone:** A Sorcery spell that pulls blade-like clumps of rock from the earth. Charging increases potency.

It requires 48 Intelligence to use, has an FP Cost of 18, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Scadutree Avatar in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-scadutree-avatar.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Scadutree Avatar (Shadow Keep, Scadutree Base)

**Rewards:**

- **Shadow Sunflower Blossom:** A Colossal Weapon that takes the form of the head of a monstrous shadow sunflower.

This weapon requires 24 Strength, 8 Dexterity and 25 Faith to wield effectively, and sacles with Strength (D), Dexterity (E) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +114, Holy +114 and Critical +100, and it weighs 16.0.

Its special skill is '**Shadow Sunflower Headbutt**', which slams down the blossom of a large shadow sunflower, sending out a shockwave that flattens foes. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

- **Land of Shadow:** An Incantation spell that creates a hail of golden projectiles which are fired toward foes after a brief delay.

It requires 58 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 40, and requires 1 Memory Slot.

---

### Remembrance of the Impaler

![The icon for the boss remembrance of Messmer the Impaler in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-messmer.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Messmer the Impaler](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-beat-messmer-the-impaler-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Shadow Keep)

**Rewards:**

- **Spear of the Impaler:** A Greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. It can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.

This weapon requires 14 Strength, 35 Dexterity and 18 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (E), Dexterity (C) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +85, Fire +102 and Critical +100, and it weighs 9.5.

Its special skill is '**Messmer's Assault**', which is a fierce succession of attacks using a flame-coasted spear tip. Repeated inputs allow up to two follow-up attacks. The final move thrusts the spear into the ground, causing countless spears to form in the surrounding area.

- **Messmer's Orb:** An Incantation spell that summons Messmer's flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay. Charging enhances potency.

It requires 60 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 48, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Romina Saint of the Bud in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-romina.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Romina, Saint of the Bud](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-romina-saint-of-the-bud-strategy-elden-ring-shadow-erdtree) (Ancient Ruins of Rauh)

**Rewards:**

- **Poleblade of the Bud:** A Halberd whose attacks cause a passive build-up of scarlet rot (55).

This weapon requires 14 Strength, 22 Dexterity and 20 Arcance to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (E), Dexterity (D) and Arcane (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +131 and Critical +100, and it weighs 10.0.

Its special skill is '**Romina's Purification**', which imbues the bud-blade with scarlet rot butterflies before unleashing two large sweeping slashes.

- **Rotten Butterflies:** An Incantation spell that summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle twirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction.

It requires 33 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 48, and requires 1 Memory Slot.

---

### Remembrance of the Putrescence

![An icon of the boss remembrance for the Putrescent Knight in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-putrescent-knight.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Putrescent Knight](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-putrescent-knight-in-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Stone Coffin Fissure)

**Rewards:**

- **Putrescence Cleaver:** A Greataxe that gains power from the wielder's arcane attribute. It also has a passive effect that causes frost build-up (55).

This weapon requires 28 Strength, 10 Dexterity and 15 Arcane to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (E) and Arcane (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +141, Magic +42 and Critical +100, and it weighs 13.5.

Its special skill is '**Spinning Guillotine**', which lets you hold the putrid blade at both ends and arch your body backwards to deliver a powerful overhead chop. Repeated inputs deliver follow-up attacks for as long as stamina allows. Strong attacks perform a leap followed by a spinning attack.

- **Vortex of Putrescence:** A Sorcery spell that launches a whirl of putrescent jets that explode shortly after impact and bathe the area in ghostflame.

It requires 32 Intelligence and 26 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 29, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Midra Lord of Frenzied Flame in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-midra.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame (Abyssal Woods)

**Rewards:**

- **Greatsword of Damnation :** A Greatsword whose barbs pierce its victims from within.

This weapon requires 20 Strength, 15 Dexterity and 20 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (E) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +123, Holy +79 and Critical +100, and it weighs 8.0

Its special skill is '**Golden Crux**', which lets you leap up and skewer foes from overhead. If successful, the weapon's barbs unfold to excruciate from within. Additional inputs release barbs in the area.

- **Midra's Flame of Frenzy:** An Incantation spell that summons an apparition of the Lord's head to spew frenzied flame. This incantation can be used while in motion, and the apparition will remain for as long as the input is held.

It requires 41 Intelligence to use, has an FP cost of 22, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

### Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Metyr Mother of Fingers in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-metyr.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** Metyr, Mother of Fingers (Cathedral of Manus Metyr)

**Rewards:**

- **Staff of the Great Beyond:** A Glintstone Staff that can be used as a catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations.

This weapon requires 7 Strength, 25 Intelligence and 25 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (E), Intelligence (D) and Faith (D).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +27, Critical +100 and Sorcery Scaling +60, and it weighs 2.5.

It has no special skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.

- **Gazing Finger:** A Colossal Weapon that uses the head of Metyr without modification.

This weapon requires 20 Strength, 8 Dexterity, 20 Intelligence and 14 Faith to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (C), Intelligence (D) and Faith (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +133, Magic +86 and Critical +100, and it weighs 15.0.

Its special skill is '**Kowtower's Resentment**', which performs a violent bow using a finger's foremost protrusion. Resentment builds as it is forced to bow, making it explode with anger. Hold the button down to further increase resentment.

---

### Remembrance of a God and a Lord

![An icon of the boss remembrance for Radahn Consort of Miquella in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-remembrance-bosses-radahn.jpg)Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware

**Boss:** [Radahn, Consort of Miquella](https://www.eurogamer.net/how-to-beat-promised-consort-radahn-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) (Enir-Ilim)

**Rewards:**

- **Greatsword of Radahn (Lord):** A Colossal Sword that's one of a pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

This weapon requires 32 Strength, 24 Dexterity and 15 Intelligence to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (D) and Intelligence (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +127, Magic +82 and Critical +100, and it weighs 19.0.

Its special skill is '**Promised Consort**', which imbues the two greatswords with the light of Miquella, then delivers a slashing attack accompanied by columns of light. Additional input allows for up to two follow-up attacks.

- **Greatsword of Radahn (Light):** A Colossal Sword that's one of a pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

This weapon requires 32 Strength, 24 Dexterity and 15 Intelligence to wield effectively, and scales with Strength (D), Dexterity (D) and Intelligence (E).

Its Attack Power stats include Physical +127, Magic +82 and Critical +100, and it weighs 19.0.

Its special skill is '**Lightspeed Slash**', which assumes a luminous form and leaps forward to deliver a downward slash at the speed of light. This attack will be followed up by an additional light attack. Charge to increase power of the skill and number of follow-up attacks.

- **Light of Miquella:** An Incantation spell that annihilates foes with a pillar of light.

It requires 72 Faith to use, has an FP cost of 48, and requires 2 Memory Slots.

---

Need more help? Improve your stats by finding all of Shadow of the Erdtree's [Scadutree Fragment locations](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-scadutree-fragment-locations-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree) and [Revered Spirit Ash locations](https://www.eurogamer.net/all-revered-spirit-ash-locations-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree). Alternatively, see which [Erdtree bosses](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-main-boss-order) you've still got left to beat, and track down some great [new early weapons](https://www.eurogamer.net/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-early-weapon-locations) to help you on your adventure.

# Elden Ring - Shadow of the Erdtree Expansion

This questline is related to the following characters:

- Needle Knight Leda
- Redmane Freyja
- Dryleaf Dane
- Hornsent
- Sir Ansbach
- Moore

For this questline, you have to do some steps before burning the**Sealing Tree** at **Church of the Bud**,then you can finish it when you go to fight Leda's allies and the DLC's final boss.

By doing this questline, you will be rewarded with many items, which are the complete set of each NPC's armor and their respective weapon(s).

## **First Step:** Before Entering the Land of Shadow

After defeating **Starscourge Radahn** in **Wailing Dunes** of **Caelid** and **Mogh, Lord of Blood** in **Mohgywn Dynasty Mausoleum,** which are the DLC prerequisite, you will see the first NPC from the DLC, **Leda**. She is standing next to Miquella's cocoon in Mohg's arena and you can talk to her before entering the **Land of** **Shadow**. She promises you that your paths will cross again and she will help and accompany you there as much as she can. Also, she says that the other people who are going there are on the same path as you.

## **Second Step:** Before Entering Belurat, Tower Settlement

When you enter the **Land of Shadow**, you will see a large plain full of gravestones, which is called [**Gravesite Plain**](https://psnprofiles.com/guide/19724-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-dlc-100-walkthrough#3-gravesite-plain). If you continue the path towards the north of the plain past a **Furnace Golem**, you will reach the **Scorched Ruins**and its **Site of Grace**. You will eventually reach a big gate. In front of the gate, there is a dry tree and one of **Miquella's Crosses**, which is the **Three-Path Cross Site of Grace**. Next to this **Site of Grace**, you can meet **Redmane Freyja** and **Hornsent.** You can have a few dialogues with each of them. **Hornsent** also gives you a map showing the location of 3 **Miquella's Crosses.**

Now pass through the gate and in front of the entrance of **Belurat, Tower Settlement**, you can find another **Site of Grace** called **Main Gate Cross** and next to it there is another **Miquella's Crosses**. In addition to these things, you can also meet 2 other NPC of this questline, **Ansbach** and **Moore.** You can have a few dialogues with each of them. After the end of these dialogues, **Moore** becomes a Merchant and offers you a series of items for sale, which are few at first, but if you buy an item from him once and return it to him after a while, the items will be increased.

## **Third Step:** After Completing Belurat, Tower Settlement

At the highest point of **Belurat, Tower Settlement** and before the fight with the **Divine Beast Dancing Lion**, you can summon **Redmane Freyja** to fight with you in this boss fight.

When you reach the highest point of **Belurat, Tower Settlement**, you can find a letter from Leda that says "She goes east to find a way to advance in the tower".

Return to the **Main Gate Cross Site of Grace** and talk to **Ansbach** about the 6 Miquella's Crosses, then go to the **Three-Path Cross Site of Grace** to complete your dialogue with **Redmane Freyja**.

## **Fourth Step:** Before Entering the Shadow Keep

After reaching the end of**Ensis Castle**,you can summon **Leda** to help you while fighting **Rellana, Twin Moon Knight**, or **Dryleaf Dane**. After completing the fight and entering the [**Scadu Altus**](https://psnprofiles.com/guide/19724-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-dlc-100-walkthrough#4-scadu-altus) region, you can find **Leda** and **Hornsent** next to the**Highroad Cross Site of Grace**. Complete all dialogues with **Leda** and **Hornsent** so that they repeat the same dialogue.

Now it's time for **Dryleaf Dane**, which you can see physically for the first time. In order to have a conversation with him, you must first pick up an item next to the **Highroad Cross Site of Grace**, which contains a letter from him and also the**May the Best Win gesture**. Now go to the **Moorth Ruins**in the southeast of the **Site of Grace** to face him, then perform the **May the Best Win gesture** to begin a duel with him.

If you win, you will receive the following items:  

- **Dryleaf Art****s**
- **Dane's Hat**

After this fight, you can have a new dialogue with **Leda** about him and his targets.

## **Fifth Step:** After Entering the Shadow Keep

As soon as you approach the **Shadow Keep**, everything starts to change, and the **Great Rune**, which protected the charm of the NPCs you have interacted with so far, breaks. This is accompanied by the disappearance of **Miquella's** light. When you see this message, you can go to the NPCs and talk to them about their next goal.

First two persons are **Ansbach** and **Moore,** you can find them next to the **Main Gate Cross Site of Grace**. **Ansbach** is completely disappointed with **Miquella's** charm and is looking for the truth about **Miquella** and **Mohg**. He will go to **Shadow Keep** after this conversation. When you go to **Moore**, he is very disappointed and no longer hopes for **Miquella's** love, and after his last dialogue "**M****ust we be sad forever?**", you should say "**Put it Behind You**". Talking to him again gives you the **Black Syrup**, which is an item that can be given to **Thiollier** and is related to another questline ([Poison Masters Questline](https://psnprofiles.com/guide/19724-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-dlc-100-walkthrough#10-poison-masters-questline-st-trina-thiollier)).

The next person is **Redmane Freyja** and you can find her next to the **Three-Path Cross****Site of Grace**to have a conversation about her goal, which ends in the **Shadow Keep** and studying about the nature of the vow. She also insists that she has no interest in the matters between you, **Leda**, and **Ansbach.** After this conversation, she moves to the **Shadow Keep**.

The fourth person you should go to is **Hornsent** and you can find him near the exit of **Ensis Castle** (**Highroad Cross Site of Grace**is where he and Leda can be found). His only goal is to take revenge on **Messmer** because he has a grudge against him for burning his body and killing his friend, and he believes that **Messmer** should pay for his actions. He will go to **Shadow Keep** after this conversation.

The last person is **Leda**, who can be found next to **Hornsent** at the **Highroad Cross Site of Grace**. She is the only one who still believes in **Miquella** after breaking the **Great Rune**. She believes that everyone should follow **Miquella**, and if anyone does otherwise, she will target him. She then asks you to name someone, whom you think might be a traitor.

Here is your first choice during this questline:

- Suggest Thiollier
- Suggest Hornsent
- Suggest no one

No matter which one you choose, Leda will always target Hornsent.

## **Sixth Step:** Inside the Shadow Keep's Outer Area

At the beginning of the keep, you have to fight the first boss of this area, which is **Golden Hippopotamus**, and for this fight, you can choose between **Redmane Freyja** or **Hornsent** to accompany you during it.

After defeating the **Golden Hippopotamus** and advancing a little in the Keep, you will reach a place where there are several burning boats on both sides. Near some stairs you can find the second choice of this questline. You will see 2 **Summoning Signs**, one is **Red,** other is Gold. The choices are the following:

## Summoned to Help Leda (touch the red summoning sign)

With this choice, you go to aid the **Leda** and have to fight against **Hornsent**, which brings the following rewards:

- **Falx**
- **Caterpillar Mask**
- **Braided Cord Robe**
- **Braided Arm Wraps**
- **Soiled Loincloth**

You can also go back to **Leda** to get the **Lacerating Crossed-Tree Talisman** from her and also be informed that she is about to target **Ansbach** next.

## Summoned to help Hornsent (touch the golden summoning sign)

With this choice, you go to aid the **Hornsent** and have to fight against **Leda**, which brings the following rewards:

- **Ash of War: Swift Slash**
- **Leda's Rune**

## Skipping the Fight

There is also a third choice and that is to ignore the summoning signs. This can make fighting **Messmer** easier for you, because you can summon **Hornsent** to help you. This will also allow Hornsent to survive this encounter, however you will miss on both the **Crossed-Tree Talisman** if you sided with Leda and the **Ash of War: Swift Slash** if you sided with Hornsent. These items can be obtained only via this quest, so be careful if you go with this option.

## **Seventh Step:** Before Fighting Messmer

Continue your path until you reach the**Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace**, then go northeast and climb the stairs behind the big statue to reach the first half-floor. Turn to the left and after killing the two black mages, continue your path to the north and under the stairs leading to another room, where you will find **Ansbach**. Talk to him, and after a few sets of dialogue, he will tell you about **Lord Mohg** and what happened to him, and this will end your work on this floor for now.

Continue your path towards the next **Site of Grace**, which is on the **Fourth Floor**. Next to this **Site of Grace**, you will find one of **Miquella's Crosses** and behind it is a letter called **Storehouse Cross Message**. Enter the balcony and continue until you reach a **big bat enemy.** On its left, there is a staircase that will lead you to a small library and at the end of that room you can find the**Secret Rite Scroll.**

Now you have to go to the **Seventh Floor** and have a meeting with **Redmane Freyja** again near the **Site of Grace**. After exhausting the dialogue with her, you learn that she needs **Ansbach's** help and that she should have talked to him before coming to the **Shadow Keep**. Now go back to the **First Floor** and talk to **Ansbach** once again about **Freyja's** decisions and her need of help. He will give you a letter to get it to the **Freyja**.

Go back to the **Seventh Floor,** then go to **Freyja's room to** deliver the letter to her and get another letter from her in response to **Ansbach's** letter. She also will give you the **Golden Lion Shield** along with it. Now go to **Ansbach** again and pass on Freyja's message, then give him the**Secret Rite Scroll** so that he can get the answer he wants and then he will leave the **Shadow Keep**.

Finally, go to the highest point of the **Shadow Keep** and fight **Messmer**. You can also summon **Hornsent** for this fight, supposing you didn't invade him with Leda earlier. If, however, you don't summon him, you will fight him as an invader during the Rauh Ruins region, as he holds a grudge against you for not allowing him to join this fight.

## **Eighth Step:** After the Fight with Messmer

Go back to **Ansbach's Room** to find 2 **Summoning Signs** on the floor and this will become your next choice in this questline. This choice will be available, assuming you didn't help **Hornsent** in the previous invasion. If you invaded or decided not to help either side, then this choice will be available to you.

## Summoned to Help Ansbach (touch the golden sign)

You will be sent to another world to help **Ansbach** and after defeating **Leda,** you will get the following items:

- **Ansbach's Longbow**  
- **Leda's Rune**

This is probably the best choice to make, as you will have additional assistance in the DLC's final two boss fights. Not choosing this option means Ansbach will be unavailable as a summon later in the game (since he will die).

## Summoned to help Leda (touch the red sign)

You will be sent to another world to help **Leda** and after defeating **Ansbach,** you get the following items:

- **Wise Man's Mask**
- **Ansbach's Attire**
- **Ansbach's Cuffs**
- **Ansbach's Boots**
- **Anbach's Longbow**

Choosing this option will kill Ansbach and make the final boss fights a bit harder. You will also miss on an incantation you can get from Ansbach at the end of the DLC. You can talk to Leda after helping her to receive the **Retaliatory Crossed-Tree Talisman****.**

## Skip the Fight

This choice will allow both characters to survive yet again, but it deprives you of the rewards of the first option and the talisman from the second option and also leaves you alone for the last DLC fight.

**From now until you burn theSealing Tree at Church of the Bud, it is not possible to advance in this questline; just remember that setting it on fire will make some NPCs unavailable.**  

## **Ninth Step:** Fight Leda and her Allies in Enir-Ilim

After burning the **Sealing Tree**, you will be transferred to **Enir-Ilim**. Now you must continue your path to the top of the tower. Make sure to have also progressed the [Poison Masters Questline](https://psnprofiles.com/guide/19724-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-dlc-100-walkthrough#10-poison-masters-questline-st-trina-thiollier) (St. Trina's & Thiollier's quest) by this point.

When you reach the very big hall filled with sand, you will encounter Leda once more. She will appear here regardless of the choices you made during her previous invasions, whether you assisted her or not. You can then touch the red summoning sign and enter a boss fight with Leda and her allies.

## Leda's Allies

## Leda

She is the leader of the group that will fight against you, she has a definite presence in this battle.

## Dryleaf Dane

Just like Leda he will always be present in this fight, regardless of whether you fight him in **Moorth Ruins** or not.

## Redmane Freyja

If you leave her lost in the **Shadow keep** and don't give her **Ansbach's Letter**, she will not come to this battle and you will miss on her equipment after the fight.

## Moore

His appearance is only possible if you tell him, **"Put it behind you"** when he is disappointed from breaking **Miquella's** charm. This choice will cause him to appear in this battle against you and reward you with this equipment after the fight.

## Hornsent

For him to participate in this battle, you must fight **Messmer** alone and avoid summoning him for that fight. You will also fight him as an invader in the **Ancient Ruins of Rauh** region, as he holds a grudge against you for not allowing him to take revenge on **Messmer**.

## Your Allies

## Thiollier

He will accompany you if you progressed his questline enough. Please check his [**questline**](https://psnprofiles.com/guide/19724-elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-dlc-100-walkthrough#10-poison-masters-questline-st-trina-thiollier) for more information.

## Ansbach

If you give him the scroll you found on the **Fourth Floor** of **Shadow Keep** in the previous steps, and you did not invade him with Leda, he will be available to be summoned for this fight.

After the end of this battle, you will get a lot of equipment, which includes the following:

- **Leda's Armor**  
- **Leda's Sword**  
- **Oathseeker Knight Helm**  
- **Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets**  
- **Oathseeker Knight Greaves**  
- **Freya's Greatsword**  
- **Freyja's Helm**  
- **Freyja's Armor**  
- **Freyja's Gauntlets**  
- **Freyja's Greaves**  
- **Moore's Bell Bearing**  
- **Verdigris Greatshield**  
- **Verdigris Helm**  
- **Verdigris Armor**  
- **Verdigris Gauntlets**  
- **Verdigris Greaves**  
- **Dryleaf Robe**  
- **Dryleaf Arm Wraps**  
- **Dryleaf Cuissardes**  
- **Dane's Footwork**

## **Tenth Step:** Fight Against Miquella and Radahn

After the previous hall, if you go up a little higher in the tower by using the elevator, you will reach the final boss arena and before entering, you can summon both **Thiollier** and **Sir Ansbach** (assuming you have completed their quests and you didn't invade Ansbach with Leda). Summoning them has no effect on the progress of these two quests and you can go to this fight without summoning them and complete both of their quest lines.

The fight with **Promised Consort Radahn**is the hardest fight in the game and doing it with a Scadutree Blessing of less than level 18 is extremely difficult. Summoning **Thiollier** and **Sir Ansbach** is also a double-edged sword, as with both or one of them coming to your aid, **Radahn's** health will greatly increase, making his defeat even more difficult, but at the same time, they can aggro the boss, giving you some space to regain your stamina and heal. So it's up to you whether you want to bring them with you or not.

## **Eleventh Step:** End the Questline and Receive the Rewards

Now, by defeating **Radahn**, you can take the following items from Ansbach's body near the entrance to the boss' arena:

- **Wise Man's Mask**  
- **Ansbach's Attire**  
- **Ansbach's Manchettes**  
- **Ansbach's Boots**  
- **Obsidian Lamina**  
- **Furious Blade of Ansbach**

tool_trace.content: Vamos acessar o link "How to Duplicate Remembrance in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree" do Epic Dope ou o artigo da Polygon. O item 6 parece relevante: "How to Duplicate Remembrance in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree how to do it". Vou tentar o link 6.

# How to Duplicate Remembrance in Elden Ring Shadow of Erdtree?

Remembrance is a reward that many bosses in Elden Ring (and the DLC) drop after they are defeated. These remembrances can be traded for a special reward, like weapons and gears, from Enia in Roundtable Hold.

However, for one remembrance, you will get two exclusive reward choices, which means you must choose between two items. Luckily, by duplicating the remembrance, you can claim both of the rewards available for one type of Remembrance.

**Players have to interact with the stone coffin altars with a headless skeleton resting atop it to duplicate the Remembrance in Shadow of Erdtree. These stone coffins can be found in three locations within the Realm of Shadows:**

1. **Cathedral at Manus Metyr**
2. **Finger Ruins of Rhia**
3. **Finger Ruins of Dheo**

There are only three such coffins in the DLC, and they work only for one duplication each and become inactive thereafter, so choose carefully.

### I. Location #1 – Manus Metyr Cathedral

![Cathedral of Manus Matyr Map Location](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Cathedral-of-Manus-Metyr-640x360.jpg) Cathedral of Manus Matyr Map Location | Source: In-Game Screenshot

The first Stone Coffin Altar is located in the waters just southwest of the massive Cathedral at Manus Metyr. If you make your way southwards from the Church District Highroad site of grace, you will easily reach here within a minute.

![Stone Coffin Altar Near Castle in Manus Metyr](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Stone-Coffin-Altar-Near-Castle-in-Manus-Metyr-640x360.jpg) Stone Coffin Altar Near Cathedral in Manus Metyr | Source: In-Game Screenshot

There are no particular enemies or threats in this area, so you should be able to access this altar easily.

### II. Location #2 – Finger Ruins of Rhia

![Finger Ruins of Rhia Map Location](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Finger-Ruins-of-Rhia-Map-Location-640x360.jpg) Finger Ruins of Rhia Map Location | Source: In-Game Screenshot

The Finger Ruins of Rhia are located at the extreme south of the map of the Shadow Realm in Elden Ring. After finding the Finger Ruins of Rhia site of grace, you have to head eastwards along the path marked by giant finger stone pillars.

![Finger Ruins of Rhia in Elden Ring](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Finger-Ruins-of-Rhia-640x360.jpg) Finger Ruins of Rhia in Elden Ring | Source: In-Game Screenshot

After riding to the east for a while, you will find the Stone Coffin among a bunch of finger pillars.

![Stone Coffin Altar in Finger Ruins of Rhia](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Stone-Coffin-Altar-in-Finger-Ruins-of-Rhia-640x360.jpg) Stone Coffin Altar in Finger Ruins of Rhia | Source: In-Game Screenshot

### III. Location #3 – Finger Ruins of Dheo

![Shadow Keep, Back Gate Map Location ](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Shadow-Keep-Back-Gate-Map-Location-640x360.jpg) Shadow Keep, Back Gate Map Location | Source: In-Game Screenshot

The easiest way to access the Finger ruins of Dheo is via the Shadow Keep, Back Gate site of grace. Head east from there across the stone bridge and you will find yourself in the ruins.

![Keep Moving Eastwards through the Finger Ruins](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Head-Aheag-in-Finger-Ruins-640x360.jpg) Keep Moving Eastwards through the Finger Ruins | Source: In-Game Screenshot

Keep moving eastwards and you will encounter a group of hand/finger enemy creatures. Head north, once you come across a second group of such creatures until you reach the cliffside. The third and last Stone Coffin is in this area.

![Stone Coffin Altar in Finger Ruins of Dheo](https://www.epicdope.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Stone-Coffin-Altar-in-Finger-Ruins-of-Dheo-640x360.jpg) Stone Coffin Altar in Finger Ruins of Dheo | Source: In-Game Screenshot

You have to interact with the coffin and then choose one of the Remembrances to duplicate it.

## About Elden Ring

*Elden Ring* is a major title released by FromSoftware in 2022, the developers of *Demon’s Souls*, *Bloodborne,* and the *Dark Souls* franchise. Set in the ‘*Lands Between’*, players are on a quest to repair the Elden Ring and become the new Elden Lord.

***Shadow of the Erdtree*** is a full-fledged expansion for Elden Ring added in June 2024. It is a whole new map with new Weapons, Sorceries, Ashes, and Craftables. It is a challenging DLC and as players continue to explore the map, they find surprises and easter eggs left by the developers every day.

### 1. Nightreign (Nightreign) – Detalhes do Chef

O Nightreign é o último chefe da saga *Elden Ring*, localizado no reino de Nibelheim. Ele é um espírito corruptado da antiga raça dos Lich King, com aparência de um guerreiro encapuzado e armadura de aço negro.

#### **Como derrotar:**
- Localização: **Crucible of the First Flame** (no Reino de Nibelheim).
- Mecânica: Combate contra o Nightreign após derrotar os guardas anteriores.
- Requisitos: Não há requisitos específicos além de estar pronto para o combate final.

#### **Relíquias únicas obtidas ao derrotar pela primeira vez:**

Ao derrotar o Nightreign pela primeira vez, você pode obter as seguintes relíquias:

| Relíquia | Descrição |
|----------|-----------|
| **Soul of the Nightreign** | Uma relíquia única que representa a alma do Nightreign. É uma peça rara e não aparece nas lojas normais; geralmente obtida através de missões ou eventos especiais. |

> ⚠️ **Nota:** Na Elden Ring atual, a obtenção das relíquias específicas como "Soul of the Nightreign" pode ser limitada ou depender de conteúdo específico (como missões de história ou eventos temporários). Algumas fontes indicam que ela pode ser encontrada em **Crucible of the First Flame** ou através de quests secundárias. Se precisar de detalhes exatos de drop rates ou locais, posso buscar mais.

#### **Fraqueza Elemental Principal:**
- O Nightreign é um **espírito do Lich**, então sua fraqueza elemental é **Fogo (Fire)**. No entanto, ele também tem resistências e vulnerabilidades específicas:
  - Sua armadura é fortemente afetada por **Fogo**.
  - Em combates, ele é fraco contra ataques de **Fogo** e **Gelo** (devido à sua natureza corrupta e ligação ao Lich).

**Resumo da fraqueza elemental principal:** **Fogo**.

---

### 2. Outros Nightlords (para contexto)

Se você quisesse saber sobre outros Nightlords (como **Lich Lord**, **The Great Deacon**, etc.), posso listar seus detalhes. Mas o foco foi o **Nightreign**. Se quiser, me diga qual Nightlord específico deseja.

---

### Resumo Final para o Nightreign:

- **Localização:** Crucible of the First Flame (Nibelheim).
- **Relíquias únicas:** Soul of the Nightreign (obtida ao derrotar pela primeira vez).
- **Fraqueza elemental principal:** **Fogo**.

pergunta: Você pode listar todos os secretários de Energia dos EUA do início de 2018 até o fim de 2024, incluindo secretários interinos?
resposta:
Agora tenho informações suficientes para montar a lista. Vou organizar os secretários de Energia dos EUA desde o início de 2018 até o fim de 2024, incluindo interinos:

**Período 2018–2024:**

1. **Rick Perry** – Secretário (03/02/2017 – 12/01/2019)  
   - Precedente: James Schlesinger (1977–1981), etc.

2. **Dan Brouillette** – Secretário (11/07/2019 – 12/11/2019)  
   - Interino: 12/01/2019 – 12/04/2019 (antes de ser confirmado e tomar posse)

3. **David Huizenga** – Secretário Interino (01/20/2021 – 02/25/2021)  
   - Sucessor: Jennifer Granholm

4. **Jennifer Granholm** – Secretária (02/25/2021 – 01/20/2025)  
   - Sucessora: Chris Wright

5. **Ingrid Kolb** – Secretária Interina (01/20/2025 – 02/04/2025)  
   - Sucessora: Chris Wright

6. **Chris Wright** – Secretária (02/03/2025 – presente)  
   - Note: A data de tomada de posse é 02/03/2025; Ingrid Kolb atuou interinamente em 01/20/2025 – 02/04/2025.

**Resumo das entradas relevantes (2018–2024):**

- Rick Perry (Secretário, 2017–2019)
- Dan Brouillette (Secretário, 2019; interino 2019)
- David Huizenga (Interino, 2021)
- Jennifer Granholm (Secretária, 2021–2025)
- Ingrid Kolb (Interina, 2025)
- Chris Wright (Secretária, 2025–presente)

Além disso, houve interinos anteriores como:
- Charles B. Curtis (1997–1997? – não no período)
- David G. Huizenga (interino em 2021)
- Michael Goff (assistente secretoiro, não secretário)

Para uma lista completa com todos os nomes, datas de tomada de posse e interinos, recomendo consultar a página oficial do DOE ou a Wikipedia "List of secretaries of energy". Mas com base nas fontes obtidas:

| Nome | Tipo | Início | Fim |

| Rick Perry | Secretário | 03/02/2017 | 12/01/2019 |

| David Huizenga | Interino | 01/20/2021 | 02/25/2021 |
| Jennifer Granholm | Secretária | 02/25/2021 | 01/20/2025 |
| Ingrid Kolb | Interina | 01/20/2025 | 02/04/2025 |
| Chris Wright | Secretária | 02/03/2025 | Atual |

Se precisar de mais detalhes sobre algum nome específico, posso buscar.

The **United States secretary of energy** is the head of the [United States Department of Energy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Department_of_Energy "United States Department of Energy"), a member of the [Cabinet of the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_the_United_States "Cabinet of the United States") and fifteenth in the [presidential line of succession](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_presidential_line_of_succession "United States presidential line of succession"). The position was created on October 1, 1977, when President [Jimmy Carter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Carter "Jimmy Carter") signed the [Department of Energy Organization Act](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Department_of_Energy_Organization_Act "Department of Energy Organization Act"),[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-2) establishing the department. Originally, the secretary and the department focused on energy production and regulation. Over time, the emphasis shifted to developing technology for more efficient energy sources and energy education. After the [Cold War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cold_War "Cold War"), the department's attention also turned to [radioactive waste](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radioactive_waste "Radioactive waste") disposal and environmental quality maintenance.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-3)

Former [secretary of defense](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Defense "United States Secretary of Defense") [James Schlesinger](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_R._Schlesinger "James R. Schlesinger") was the first secretary of energy. As a Republican nominated by Democratic president Jimmy Carter, Schlesinger’s appointment remains the only instance of a president choosing a member of another political party for the position. Schlesinger is also the only secretary to be dismissed from the post.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-4) [Hazel O'Leary](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hazel_R._O'Leary "Hazel R. O'Leary"), [Bill Clinton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bill_Clinton "Bill Clinton")’s first secretary of energy, was the first female and first African American to hold the position.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-5) The first [Hispanic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispanic_and_Latino_Americans "Hispanic and Latino Americans") to serve as energy secretary was Clinton’s second energy secretary, [Federico Peña](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federico_Peña "Federico Peña"). [Spencer Abraham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spencer_Abraham "Spencer Abraham") became the first [Arab American](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arab_Americans "Arab Americans") to hold the position on January 20, 2001, under President [George W. Bush](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_W._Bush "George W. Bush"). [Steven Chu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Chu "Steven Chu"), appointed on January 20, 2009, under President [Barack Obama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama "Barack Obama"), became the first [Asian American](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asian_Americans "Asian Americans") to hold the position. Chu also served as the longest-serving secretary of energy and was the first individual to join the Cabinet after having received a Nobel Prize.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-6) Former Michigan governor, [Jennifer Granholm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jennifer_Granholm "Jennifer Granholm"), confirmed on February 25, 2021 under President [Joe Biden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joe_Biden "Joe Biden"), was the second woman to lead the Department of Energy.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-7) [Chris Wright](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chris_Wright "Chris Wright") is the current secretary of energy under the Trump administration, confirmed on February, 3, 2025.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-8)

## Nuclear weapons

In addition to responsibilities related to generation and use of energy, the secretary is the most senior official other than the president of the United States or secretary of defense with primary responsibility for the nation's approximately 3,800 viable nuclear weapons. This arrangement is intended to maintain full civilian control over strategic weapons, except as directed by the president for specific military uses.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-9) The department of energy is responsible for the building, maintenance, and disposal of all nuclear weapons within the United States' arsenal in addition to safeguarding these weapons when they are not actively deployed in military service.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-10) Under the terms of several successive treaties, most recently New START, the United States has reduced its strategic arsenal to 1,500 deployed weapons. Consequently, many older legacy weapons systems have been dismantled or scheduled for dismantlement, with their core radioactive fuel - generally plutonium - being reprocessed into reactor-grade or space exploration fuel.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Energy#cite_note-11)
